expectations.text: Flags lodash@4.17.15 for the prototype pollution CVE (CVE-2020-8203) and recommends upgrading to >=4.17.19 or later
expectations.evidence: 'lodash@4.17.15 — CVE-2020-8203 Prototype Pollution (HIGH, security). Patched in >=4.17.19'.

expectations.text: Flags pdf-stamp as an AGPL-3.0 production dependency, noting the copyleft/network-use risk and recommending legal review or substitution
expectations.evidence: 'pdf-stamp@2.1.0 — AGPL-3.0 license (HIGH, legal risk) ... flag to legal/eng leadership before next release', with pdf-lib/pdfkit alternatives.

expectations.text: Flags moment as an unused production dependency — no import found anywhere in source or config — and recommends removing it
expectations.evidence: 'moment@2.24.0 — unused (MEDIUM, hygiene). No file in the repo references it. Action: remove from package.json'.

expectations.text: Does NOT flag tailwindcss as unused, because it is required via require('tailwindcss') in postcss.config.js even though no source file imports it directly
expectations.evidence: 'tailwindcss@3.4.1 (LOW, hygiene). Actively used, no known CVE.' Not flagged as unused.

expectations.text: Does NOT flag pdf-stamp or lodash as unused, since both have a genuine import in src/
expectations.evidence: Both are described as used in real code paths, neither flagged unused.

expectations.text: Gives a concrete upgrade command or version target for lodash rather than a vague 'update lodash' instruction
expectations.evidence: 'bump to ^4.17.21 (picks up this fix plus later ones, e.g. CVE-2020-28500)'.
